Each Booster Display Case contains 6 Jumpstart 2022 Booster Displays.
The Jumpstart 2022 Booster Display contains 24 Magic: The Gathering Jumpstart Boosters. Each Jumpstart 2022 Booster contains 1 insert indicating the pack’s theme and 20 Magic cards revolving around that theme, including 1 card with anime-inspired art, a total of 1–2 cards of rarity Rare or higher, and all the lands you need to play. To play with even more wild theme combos, Jumpstart 2022 Boosters can be combined with packs from any other Jumpstart product.
• 24 Jumpstart 2022 MTG boosters
• 20 Magic cards in each booster—includes all the lands you need to play
• 1 anime-inspired card in every pack
• Total of 1–2 cards of rarity Rare or higher in every pack
• Each booster has 1 of 46 possible themes—combine them for wild mash ups
• Just grab 2 boosters, shuffle them together, and play!
